metadata.title: Aura core storefront sales copy — audit-ready packet
metadata.mode: Selection and grouping only; no copy audit, rewrite, score, recommendation or implementation.

visibility_filter_evidence.condition: Sticky is hidden on desktop; sticky size line is hidden on mobile

metadata.count_policy: Count each retained master ID once; shared sections appear on both complete pages but are counted once. Customer-facing elements include exact dynamic-format records; external placeholders are counted separately. Section count is 26 enabled theme instances plus 2 purchase components; SEO metadata blocks are separate.
metadata.active_policy: Active means enabled/eligible according to the completed inventories, not verified against a live storefront. User-triggered FAQ, size-guide, cart and bundle states remain conditional. Master copy remains authoritative. Narrow read-only checks of the material-badge gate and sticky-bar CSS were used only to remove non-visible candidates, not to extract or change copy. No live Shopify rendering was accessed.
metadata.copy_policy: exact_copy and source_expression are preserved byte-for-byte as decoded strings from the master JSON, checked against the master Markdown. HTML, interpolation, punctuation and current errors remain unchanged. Null copy is an existing dynamic record or external placeholder, never invented copy.
metadata.claim_policy: One marker per flagged retained element: claim to verify. No substantiation judgment, severity, conclusion or proposed change is attached. Flags are counted by unique element ID, not by repeated display or sentence.
metadata.scope: Homepage and product page, shared global/header/footer/newsletter, active purchase components and homepage/product SEO bindings. Standalone size-guide/delivery pages excluded; their copy is included only where already present in this purchase journey.
